newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 28.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on May 28:
WASHINGTON - Federal Communications Commission Chairman Reed Hundt announced his resignation, saying he wanted to spend more time with his family.
WASHINGTON - Rupert Murdoch's News Corp. may get into the United States' fast-growing satellite TV business after all if a deal with Primestar Partners comes off.
WASHINGTON - The Supreme Court let stand a lower court ruling awarding more than $4 million to a partner at one of the nation's largest accounting firms who had sued for age discrimination.
WASHINGTON - The management of the Student Loan Marketing Association and a group of dissident shareholders have agreed to a showdown vote of stockholders to decide who will run the company.

WASHINGTON - A group of 40 District business, community and government leaders launched a voluntary campaign to create technology training courses and computer networks in D.C. schools and community organizations.
